headline: July Inflation Is Out! The Figure That Will Affect Millions of Retirees' and Civil Servants' Salaries Is Announced
summary: Turkish Statistical Institute data showed consumer prices rose 1.78% month on month in July and 31.75% year on year. The figures will affect salaries of retirees and civil servants.
why: The Turkish Statistical Institute (TÜİK) publishes the official inflation data that drives central bank policy and wage indexation in Türkiye.
